item.title: Carney dice EEUU debe empezar a ser serio antes de que puedan reanudarse negociaciones comerciales
item.description: El primer ministro canadiense, Mark Carney, dijo el martes a la prensa que "Estados Unidos tiene que empezar a tomarse las cosas en serio y dejar de intentar mostrarse duro antes de que puedan reanudarse las negociaciones sobre un posible acuerdo comercial con Canadá".
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El primer ministro canadiense, Mark Carney, dijo el martes a la prensa que "Estados Unidos tiene que empezar a tomarse las cosas en serio y dejar de intentar mostrarse duro antes de que puedan reanudarse las negociaciones sobre un posible acuerdo comercial con Canadá". Canadá se retiró el 21 de agosto de las negociaciones sobre un acuerdo para evitar aranceles adicionales por parte de Washington, alegando que la parte estadounidense había planteado exigencias inaceptables de última hora. Desde entonces, el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, ha declarado que el lago Ontario debería pasar a llamarse "lago América", ha calificado a los líderes canadienses como "los peores" con los que ha tenido que tratar y ha reiterado sus afirmaciones de que Canadá está estafando a Estados Unidos. También publicó un meme generado por inteligencia artificial en el que se veía a gansos canadienses con el característico peinado de Trump desfilando bajo una bandera estadounidense. Carney afirmó que aún hay posibilidad de alcanzar un acuerdo comercial mutuamente beneficioso que respete la soberanía canadiense. "Y cuando los estadounidenses dejen de hacer memes, dejen de lanzar pullas, dejen de intentar mostrarse duros y empiecen a tomarse en serio esas conversaciones, podremos mantenerlas", comentó Carney, añadiendo que las recientes acciones de Washington "no son constructivas". Las autoridades estadounidenses han cuestionado parte de la versión canadiense sobre los motivos del fracaso de las negociaciones, alegando que había una buena oferta sobre la mesa. Carney dijo que Ottawa nunca consideró adecuadas las condiciones propuestas, sobre todo en lo referente al sector del automóvil, altamente integrado. "La actitud de Estados Unidos (…) ha sido que las industrias clave canadienses o bien se convertirían, en la práctica, en filiales de las industrias estadounidenses, o bien (Washington) impondría condiciones que llevarían a la reducción gradual y, finalmente, a la desaparición de esas industrias en Canadá", señaló. "Por supuesto, no vamos a aceptar esas condiciones".

item.title: Dutch police arrest 34 people after shooting in rural village
item.description: Dutch police on Tuesday said 34 suspects from several countries were arrested after a shooting in which a man was killed and two police officers were wounded in the early hours.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dutch police on Tuesday said 34 suspects from several countries were arrested after a shooting in which a man was killed and two police officers were wounded in the early hours. The head of the regional police, Jolanda Aalbers, told reporters a "large group" of masked men opened fire when police arrived at a house where suspicious activities had been reported in Overasselt, a village in the east of the Netherlands. Among those arrested were suspects from the Netherlands, Belgium, France and Algeria, regional prosecutors said. Prosecutors said there were indications of a "long running" conflict, in which the same house had been shot at last year. Two people were convicted in that incident. Police found a man with serious injuries who later died of his injuries. Two police officers who were wounded by the gunfire were taken to hospital, Aalbers said.

item.title: US pushes G20 to cut trade imbalances, focus on China
item.description: The Trump administration was pushing on Tuesday for G20 countries to agree ways to reduce global trade and fiscal imbalances as another bond market sell-off revives worries about growing debt levels and renewed inflation pressures.
item.dc:creator: Philip Blenkinsop, David Lawder
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration was pushing on Tuesday for G20 countries to agree ways to reduce global trade and fiscal imbalances as another bond market sell-off revives worries about growing debt levels and renewed inflation pressures. A sell-off in global bond markets deepened on Tuesday, with Japan's 10-year bond yield hitting 3% for the first time since 1996, the latest manifestation of market angst about energy-driven inflation, potential monetary tightening and worsening fiscal conditions. Government bond yields rose in major economies including the United States, Japan, the euro zone and Germany as well as Britain, where the bond yields surged 10 basis points after a public holiday on Monday amid fresh worries over renewed attacks in the Middle East. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Reuters on Sunday that he would [USN:L1N44S001 TEXT:"urge"] G20 members to re-examine their terms of trade with China and consider higher trade barriers to Chinese goods to pressure Beijing to rebalance its economy away from exports and toward domestic consumption. China's massive export push has pressured economies across the globe, especially as the United States has imposed high tariffs on Chinese goods and outright bans on some products, such as Chinese vehicles. With chronically weak domestic demand, China has doubled down on [USN:L6N43T1BB TEXT:"exports of electric vehicles"], semiconductors and other goods, and its total exports rose 23.9% in July year-on-year, prompting growing calls in the EU for [USN:L6N42O0M6 TEXT:"tougher curbs on Chinese imports"]. It remains unclear whether the U.S. will be able to bring the diverse forum together to agree on a joint communique on how to reduce global imbalances. G20 member China has shown little interest in longstanding calls for it to reduce industrial subsidies and rebalance its economy, while its yuan currency remains significantly undervalued by most measures. The U.S. has thus far not produced a critical plan to reduce its excessive fiscal deficits, which economists say is essential for reducing its $1 trillion-plus annual global trade deficit. European Economy Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis agreed that China is a major source of global economic imbalances, but that the U.S. and Europe have their roles to play in a more balanced global economy. "To put short the summary of this analysis, which we have been doing over the upscale couple of years, China would need to spend more, U.S. would need to spend less, and EU would need to invest more." "It's important that all economic blocs take action to address the imbalances that increases obviously the efficiency of global policy response, and that obviously concerns also specifically China," Dombrovskis said. "And of course, another important element is just mentioning that everyone needs to see how it is a growth agenda for everyone. So also China needs to see how it is a growth agenda for China." China's goods trade surplus with the European Union hit €360.6 billion last year, a 15% increase on 2024, and has expanded further this year as Chinese firms have sold more to the EU and imported less. Polish Finance Minister Andrzej Domanski said that he supported the U.S. view that China’s trade surplus with partners was a major problem, adding that the European Union was taking steps to address the issue, such as imposing customs duties on e-commerce parcels, most coming from China. "We do know that Chinese currency is hugely undervalued, that China is supporting very actively subsidizing its exports and this is a problem for Europe as well,” he told Reuters late on Monday. “Many, many European countries have these high deficits with China, and definitely we need to take action." Beijing has also exploited its dominance in processing of critical minerals by placing export restrictions on rare earths in April 2025, a response to U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs that has also hit non-U.S. companies. Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama, speaking at a news briefing on Monday evening after the first day of talks, said she had told her G20 counterparts that arbitrary export restrictions on critical minerals were harming the global economy and should be withdrawn. Officials said the section on global imbalances in the planned joint communique was proving particularly difficult, with China opposed to any singling out of 'non-market economies' or firm words on critical mineral supply curbs. European countries were also keen to include strong language critical of Russia's war against Ukraine. Many European ministers expressed [USN:L6N44S10G TEXT:"surprise and dismay"] to see Russian Finance Minister Anton Siluanov sitting at the G20 table when U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent opened the meeting on Monday, the first time Russia has attended the forum in person since it invaded Ukraine in 2022.

item.title: El gasto en construcción en EEUU cae en julio a un mínimo de casi tres años
item.description: El gasto en construcción en Estados Unidos cayó de forma inesperada en julio, a un mínimo de casi tres años, ya que el aumento de las tasas hipotecarias lastró la construcción de viviendas unifamiliares.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El gasto en construcción en Estados Unidos cayó de forma inesperada en julio, a un mínimo de casi tres años, ya que el aumento de las tasas hipotecarias lastró la construcción de viviendas unifamiliares. La Oficina del Censo del Departamento de Comercio informó el martes de que el gasto en construcción bajó un 0,5%, a 2,158 billones de dólares, el más bajo desde octubre de 2023. Los datos de junio se revisaron al alza, de modo que el gasto en construcción se mantuvo sin cambios en lugar del descenso del 0,1%, del que se había informado antes. Los economistas encuestados por Reuters habían pronosticado que el gasto en construcción se mantendría sin cambios en julio. El gasto en construcción se desplomó un 3,8% en términos interanuales en julio. El gasto en proyectos privados disminuyó un 0,5%, la inversión residencial se desplomó un 1,3% y el gasto en proyectos de viviendas unifamiliares cayó un 3,2%, y un 6,5% en términos interanuales. La construcción de viviendas también se ve afectada por un exceso de casas unifamiliares sin vender. La tasa promedio de la popular hipoteca de tipo fijo a 30 años ronda el máximo anual del 6,66%, según datos de la agencia hipotecaria Freddie Mac, y ha subido casi 70 puntos básicos desde que comenzó la guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán a finales de febrero.

item.title: GoPro vende participação de 90% à fabricante de produtos ópticos Starman
item.description: Uma fabricante pouco conhecida de componentes ópticos está adquirindo a GoPro por US$285 milhões em dinheiro, um negócio que cobre a dívida da fabricante de câmeras de ação e lhe dá mais margem de manobra para lidar com a alta nos preços dos chips de memória e a forte concorrência chinesa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Uma fabricante pouco conhecida de componentes ópticos está adquirindo a GoPro (GPRO.O) por US$285 milhões em dinheiro, um negócio que cobre a dívida da fabricante de câmeras de ação e lhe dá mais margem de manobra para lidar com a alta nos preços dos chips de memória e a forte concorrência chinesa. A Starman Optical, uma empresa privada que fabrica transceptores ópticos nos EUA para uso em centros de dados de IA, ficará com 90% da GoPro conforme o acordo anunciado nesta terça-feira, com os acionistas atuais da fabricante de câmeras detendo o restante. As empresas afirmaram em um comunicado conjunto que o acordo posiciona melhor a GoPro, que depende do mercado de consumo, para capitalizar suas mais de 2.500 patentes nos EUA, inclusive em soluções ópticas e de imagem, ao explorar os mercados comercial, militar e de inteligência artificial. As ações da GoPro subiram mais de 50% com a notícia, sendo negociadas a US$1,33, acima do preço de oferta de US$1,14 por ação, o que representou um prêmio de cerca de 29,5% em relação ao fechamento da véspera. Isso sugere que os investidores estão esperando uma oferta mais alta. Depois de atingir uma valorização de US$4 bilhões em seu primeiro dia de negociação em 2014, as ações da GoPro perderam cerca de 96% de seu valor, à medida que a empresa passou enfrentar dificuldades nos últimos anos diante da crescente concorrência de rivais chineses, como DJI e Insta 360. A receita da GoPro no trimestre encerrado em junho caiu mais de 80% em relação ao pico de US$633,9 milhões atingido nos últimos três meses de 2014. Um recente aumento nos preços dos chips de memória, impulsionado pela expansão da infraestrutura de IA das grandes empresas de tecnologia, agravou a pressão, forçando a GoPro a alertar, em junho, sobre dúvidas substanciais quanto ao seu futuro. Como parte do acordo firmado nesta terça-feira, a Starman incorporará seus transceptores ópticos, componentes que permitem que equipamentos de rede enviem dados por meio da luz, ao portfólio da GoPro. As empresas também afirmaram que pretendem trazer de volta aos EUA a produção de alguns equipamentos ópticos essenciais, sem especificar um cronograma. Várias empresas, incluindo a Allbirds, agora conhecida como Smartbird, mudaram seu foco para a IA nos últimos meses, atraídas por um aumento nos investimentos no setor. Ao contrário de algumas delas, a GoPro continuará com seus negócios voltados para o consumidor final. A empresa, que possui cerca de US$92 milhões em dívidas pendentes, também permanecerá listada na bolsa após a conclusão do negócio, prevista para o final do ano. (Por Prathik Jayaprakash)

item.title: Purdue strives to improve on defense in opener vs. Indiana State
item.description: Purdue surrendered an average of 8.1 fewer points per game last season than in the previous campaign but realizes there's plenty of room for improvement on defense in Friday's season opener against Indiana State in West Lafayette, Ind.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Purdue surrendered an average of 8.1 fewer points per game last season than in the previous campaign but realizes there's plenty of room for improvement on defense in Friday's season opener against Indiana State in West Lafayette, Ind. Opponents still averaged 31.8 points a game against the Boilermakers in 2025. A unit that includes a mix of returners and additions from the transfer portal comprises incumbents such as top linebacker Charles Correa and defensive lineman Ian Jeffries alongside lineman Curt Neal, a transfer from Illinois who opened his collegiate career at Wisconsin. "We have jelled so much together," Jeffries said. "It's almost like we've been playing since we've been in high school." Relying on such comfort offensively also looks to be the strategy for coach Barry Odom in his second season at Purdue. Ryan Browne returns as starting quarterback and again will work behind an offensive line anchored by left tackle Joey Tanona. Ethan Trent might be a mainstay on a front five that added numerous options through the portal as Purdue seeks to improve on a 2-10 record from last season. Indiana State, meanwhile, will aim to avoid falling to 0-2 to begin this season. Fueled by a bounce-back effort from quarterback Elijah Owens, who missed most of 2025 with a collarbone injury, the Sycamores rallied from a 17-7 deficit early in the third quarter of their season opener against visiting Southeast Missouri State on Saturday but couldn't hold on to win. A 25-yard scoring pass from Owens to Jayden Reed put the Sycamores ahead 21-20 with 10:26 remaining before the Redhawks responded with a 45-yard Justin Keller field goal with 7:04 left to earn a 23-21 victory. Owens was 23-for-32 passing for a career-best 288 yards and two touchdowns, with one interception. "This is a team that has been together, and that's what we're going to keep preaching," Sycamores coach Curt Mallory said. "We've got to keep fighting together, and we'll get back on track." Purdue enters on a seven-game winning streak in the in-state rivalry, taking the past two meetings by a combined score of 105-0. The Sycamores will be the Boilermakers' lone Football Championship Subdivision foe this season. Purdue will host Wake Forest next week before attempting to stop an 18-game Big Ten losing streak when it visits UCLA on Sept. 19. --Field Level Media

item.title: Sky G Skylar Diggins (knee) shut down for season
item.description: Chicago Sky guard Skylar Diggins is being shut down for the remainder of the season due to a knee injury, the team announced Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chicago Sky guard Skylar Diggins is being shut down for the remainder of the season due to a knee injury, the team announced Tuesday. The Sky (15-25) have been eliminated from postseason contention, leaving the club with little reason to risk putting the seven-time All-Star on the court. Per a statement from the team, it wants to "prioritize Skylar's long-term health after collaboration and communication with Skylar and her team, Sky doctors, and the organization's medical staff." Diggins, 36, has been sidelined since early July. She averaged 14.2 points and 4.9 assists in 19 games (all starts) during her first season with the team. Diggins has contributed 16.3 points and 5.3 assists in 354 career appearances (341 starts) with the Tulsa/Dallas franchise, Phoenix Mercury, Seattle Storm and Sky. --Field Level Media

item.title: Equipe econômica de Flávio Bolsonaro cita "tecnologia" como resposta para desigualdade de renda
item.description: A economista Daniella Marques, coordenadora do núcleo econômico da campanha do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) à Presidência da República, citou nesta terça-feira o investimento em tecnologia como resposta para a redução da desigualdade de renda entre pobres e ricos no Brasil.
item.dc:creator: Fabricio Castro
item.content:encoded: A economista Daniella Marques, coordenadora do núcleo econômico da campanha do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) à Presidência da República, citou nesta terça-feira o investimento em tecnologia como resposta para a redução da desigualdade de renda entre pobres e ricos no Brasil. Questionada pela Reuters sobre qual é a proposta do programa de Flávio Bolsonaro para a redução da discrepância de renda entre pobres e ricos no Brasil, Marques afirmou que o foco está na tecnologia. "Hoje todos nós, seja o setor produtivo, seja o brasileiro, absorvemos o efeito da gastança deste governo, da maior taxa de juro real do mundo. Uma das maiores cargas tributárias do mundo está embutida nos preços e nas dívidas das famílias e das empresas", disse Marques em coletiva de imprensa, durante o Seminário Empresarial LIDE - Cenários do Brasil, em São Paulo. "Então, a gente inverte esta lógica no programa, enxergando na internet a infraestrutura do futuro, levando oportunidade e dignidade e capacitação na palma da mão dos brasileiros para que eles possam crescer e não ser prisioneiros de programas de assistencialismo", acrescentou. Ex-presidente da Caixa Econômica Federal durante o governo de Jair Bolsonaro, Marques não se aprofundou na proposta, nem nos eventuais efeitos da tecnologia para a redução da discrepância de renda no país. Dados do Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE) mostram que o rendimento médio mensal real de todas as fontes da população residente no Brasil alcançou R$3.367 em 2025, uma alta de 5,4% em relação ao ano anterior. Ainda assim, o índice de Gini, que mede a desigualdade de renda entre os brasileiros, aumentou de 0,487 para 0,491 no ano passado. Quanto maior o índice, maior a desigualdade. Ao responder ao mesmo questionamento sobre redução da discrepância de renda no Brasil, o consultor Adolfo Sachsida, ex-ministro de Minas e Energia no governo Jair Bolsonaro, citou a necessidade de um "tripé econômico". "Desafio urgente: consolidação fiscal. Desafio importante: aumento de produtividade. Terceiro (item do) tripé: inclusão social produtiva", citou Sachsida. "Vamos precisar de um amplo programa de inclusão social para dar a chance para o brasileiro voltar a sonhar", acrescentou, sem se aprofundar. Marques e Sachsida participaram do evento do LIDE ao lado de outros economistas, como Henrique Meirelles, ex-ministro da Fazenda e ex-presidente do Banco Central, Caio Megale, economista-chefe da XP Investimentos, Cassiana Fernandez, economista-chefe do JP Morgan, e Felipe Salto, economista-chefe da Warren. A organização do evento informou que economistas ligados ao PT também foram convidados para o evento, mas não aceitaram. O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) e Flávio Bolsonaro lideram as pesquisas de intenção de voto para o Planalto.

item.title: Intesa sees no impact on MPS takeover offer from Consob requests or defence bids, source says
item.description: Intesa Sanpaolo does not expect its buyout offer for Monte dei Paschi di Siena to be hampered by defence bids mounted by its takeover target or by clarifications sought by Italy's markets watchdog, a person close to the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) does not expect its buyout offer for Monte dei Paschi di Siena (BMPS.MI) to be hampered by defence bids mounted by its takeover target or by clarifications sought by Italy's markets watchdog, a person close to the matter said. Italian daily La Stampa reported on Tuesday that markets authority Consob had written to Intesa to ask about the potential impact on its Monte dei Paschi (MPS) offer of two counter bids unveiled last month by the Tuscan lender. In an effort to thwart Intesa's €35 billion cash-and-share buyout scheme unveiled [USN:L8N44L0HH TEXT:"in June"], MPS in August outlined plans for two simultaneous bids worth in total €36 billion. It is proposing to buy rival mid-sized bank Banco BPM (BAMI.MI) as well as wealth manager Banca Generali (BGN.MI) , paying in shares. Under Italian takeover rules, MPS needs shareholder approval to proceed and it has called a vote on the matter on October 29. The source said the two MPS bids had no impact whatsoever unless its shareholders cleared them at the October meeting. If the two bids are approved, Intesa will have the right to walk away from its own offer. Intesa shareholders are called on to approve the MPS acquisition on September 10, and the tender period for the offer is expected to start in October after supervisory green lights including that of Consob. Intesa will answer Consob's requests in a transparent and cooperative manner so as to aide the process that is set to culminate in Consob's approval of the offer's prospectus, the person said.

item.title: Crunch time (again) at VW
item.description: Greetings from London!
item.dc:creator: Nick Carey
item.content:encoded: Greetings from London! I have just returned from a couple of weeks soaking up some Mediterranean sunshine in southern England, which in the current drought felt more like Tuscany. My young son has recently discovered what I do for a living and spent much of the holiday announcing the brand names of all the cars we saw. That included a not insignificant number of Chinese brand cars – BYD, Omoda, Changan, Jaecoo, Leapmotor, a couple of Xpengs and even a Geely. This was a far cry from the game of “Name That Brand” that I have engaged in with colleagues on visits to China – where sooner or later we all get stumped by a brand we do not recognize. But it is a sign of the change that is taking place on roads from England to South Africa and many countries in between as Chinese brands rush to expand globally. Which brings us to today’s Auto File… Blume takes [USN:S8N4130CN TEXT:"another swing"] Honda, Toyota dented by [USN:L4N44P0I6 TEXT:"Trump’s"] Canada tariffs Merz under pressure over [USN:L8N44O0MW TEXT:"China"] VW cuts go back to board Earlier this summer, Volkswagen CEO Oliver Blume tried and [USN:L8N43B21S TEXT:"failed"] to persuade the carmaker’s supervisory board to accept his proposal to slash jobs and shutter factories in Germany, its home market. Blume will take a second bite at that apple later this week. But this time he faces [USN:L8N44M0F8 TEXT:"two opposing proposals"] submitted by labour and state government stakeholders. The contents of those proposals are not clear, but presumably they would not entail tens of thousands of job cuts and factory closures. The state premier of Lower Saxony, which is VW’s second-largest shareholder, says there is pressure on all sides to [USN:L8N44Q01M TEXT:"cut a deal"]. A nuclear option left to VW’s management if they fail to muster enough support at this week’s board meeting is to call an [USN:L8N44O1C5 TEXT:"emergency shareholder meeting"]. Though this path runs the risk of a lengthy legal dispute between shareholders, it would allow VW to put its plan to investors who would be more amenable to making cuts to better compete against rapidly expanding Chinese rivals. Recommended reading: Iran war lifts U.S. [USN:L6N43N13L TEXT:"fuel surcharges"] Chinese robots not ready for human work [USN:L8N44N1OO TEXT:"Hormuz blockade"] slows Iran’s oil flow Honda, Toyota’s tariff pain The auto industry was [USN:L6N44N0VK TEXT:"taken by surprise"] by the trade war between the U.S. and Canada, as it had assumed a deal was coming. But now, instead of 25% tariffs, automakers face [USN:L8N44L114 TEXT:"50%"] U.S. tariffs on all cars and trucks imported from Canada. This is guaranteed to hurt an industry where cross-border supply chains and factories have evolved without issue until U.S. President Donald Trump’s second stint in office. Automakers and suppliers will have to adjust to that pain, but as Reuters colleagues Daniel Leussink and Maki Shiraki report, it will be hardest for Toyota and Honda to adjust. You can read all about it [USN:L4N44P0I6 TEXT:"here"]. The two Japanese automakers account for more than three-quarters of all cars made in Canada. Analysts say they could be forced to shutter some production lines if the tariffs go into effect on January 1 as proposed. Canadian-built cars accounted for almost a quarter of Honda's U.S. sales and 17% of Toyota's last year, the most among major automakers, according to Barclays analysts. As a result, the two face the biggest potential hit from Trump's plan. Pressure on Merz over China Just two years ago, [USN:L8N3LG093 TEXT:"Germany voted against"] the EU’s proposed tariffs on Chinese-made EVs largely because its carmakers feared retaliation in China where they sold around a third of their new cars. What a difference two years make. Volkswagen has taken a pounding in China over the last six years as local brands like BYD have taken share. It has been joined more recently by BMW and Mercedes, which now face local premium Chinese brands keen on pinching their customers. But their problems have not stopped there, as China’s automakers are growing rapidly in Europe, the home turf of those very same German automakers. Now German automakers alongside other titans of German industry are pressing Chancellor Friedrich Merz to take a tougher line with Beijing, with companies calling for stronger action to address what they describe as unfair competition from Chinese rivals. If an EU vote comes up on tariffs for Chinese-made plug-in hybrids, it will be interesting to see which way Germany votes this time around. China touts auto safety For years, China has gone along with whatever safety issues have been championed in Europe or the U.S. market. But with a [USN:L4N44I0OQ TEXT:"huge recall"] last month pushing automakers to fix door safety issues, China is now [USN:L4N44L08X TEXT:"spearheading"] new auto safety standards for some of the world's most advanced cars. Shortly after that major recall, Chinese regulators ordered automakers to file [USN:L4N44O0XJ TEXT:"proactive recall plans"] for any defects uncovered in self-audits, as part of a year-long campaign to improve vehicle quality and safety in the world's largest auto market. While Chinese automakers have rolled out features like fast-charging batteries and advanced self-driving software with breathtaking speed, analysts say they have often prioritised user experience and aesthetics over other considerations. Now Chinese regulators appear to be moving the industry in a new direction, increasing oversight and introducing rules requiring automakers to track the condition and repair history of all EVs sold. Setting the tone on auto safety matters, as it moves the industry’s center of gravity closer to Beijing. Fast Laps VinFast has [USN:L4N44N0Y9 TEXT:"suspended plans"] to manufacture three EVs in India and ordered suppliers to halt work on the projects while it reassesses costs, according to two sources and a company memo reviewed by Reuters — year after the Vietnamese automaker entered a crucial growth market. General Motors plans to assemble a [USN:L1N44Q051 TEXT:"heavy-duty pickup"] at an Ontario plant as part of a tentative deal with a key union that would pump C$1.1 billion ($791.3 million) into Canada's auto sector as it reels from U.S. tariffs, according to a union bargaining report. Chinese EV maker BYD posted its first rise in [USN:L4N44P0C3 TEXT:"quarterly profit"] in more than a year, helped by a surge in exports that offset weak domestic sales. Toyota said its global vehicle sales and production [USN:L1N44P02Y TEXT:"fell in July"], weighed by declines in China, the United States and the Middle East, which offset a stronger performance in Japan. item.title: Details emerge about alleged TCU beating, player dismissal
item.description: Details are coming out about the dismissal of TCU safety Jacob Fields, who is facing criminal charges over an alleged locker room assault last month.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Details are coming out about the dismissal of TCU safety Jacob Fields, who is facing criminal charges over an alleged locker room assault last month. Dallas television station WFAA reported Monday that it had obtained a copy of the arrest warrant, which detailed the alleged campus assault. The affidavit said TCU wide receiver Dozie Ezukanma spent three days in a hospital due to a concussion, brain bleed and other injuries after allegedly being assaulted by Fields. The WFAA report, citing the affidavit, said Ezukanma was looking at his phone on Aug. 13, when Fields approached him inside the Walsh Athletic Complex at TCU and punched and kicked him in the head. Ezukanma lost consciousness, but when he came to, he told TCU's medical staff that his ears were ringing and his head hurt. Two CT scans at the hospital uncovered the brain bleed. It is not known how much time Ezukanma will miss this season. Fields was a transfer student from Louisiana Tech, where he was named the Co-Defensive Player of the Year in 2025 for Conference USA. A senior safety, Fields was expected to win a starting job. Speculation is that Fields was angry about being outplayed by Ezukanma. Fields was released by TCU on Aug. 18. He turned himself in on Sunday and faces a charge of aggravated assault causing serious bodily injury. He posted a $50,000 bond. TCU opened its season on Saturday with a 15-10 loss to North Carolina. The Horned Frogs next play Sept. 12 against Grambling State in Fort Worth. --Field Level Media

item.title: Bessent diz que EUA provavelmente anunciarão sanções contra bancos iranianos nesta semana
item.description: O secretário do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos, Scott Bessent, disse nesta terça-feira que os EUA provavelmente anunciarão sanções contra um banco nesta semana, como parte de sua campanha econômica contra o Irã.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O secretário do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos, Scott Bessent, disse nesta terça-feira que os EUA provavelmente anunciarão sanções contra um banco nesta semana, como parte de sua campanha econômica contra o Irã. “Provavelmente anunciaremos uma sanção contra um banco nesta semana e anunciaremos outra na semana seguinte. Estamos conversando com nossos aliados aqui, que se manifestaram em uníssono, e recebemos uma grande demonstração de apoio”, disse Bessent. Ao discursar em um evento paralelo à reunião dos líderes financeiros do Grupo dos 20, organizada pelos EUA em Asheville, no Estado norte-americano da Carolina do Norte, o secretário do Tesouro disse que os EUA também estão considerando visar empresas de leasing de aeronaves e outras entidades que mantêm relações comerciais com a Guarda Revolucionária Islâmica do Irã (IRGC). “Podem ser entidades. Podem ser empresas de leasing de aeronaves, que estaremos analisando. Pode ser qualquer um que faça negócios com a IRGC. Estamos rastreando os ativos da IRGC”, disse Bessent. “Temos tolerância zero. Vamos asfixiar economicamente esse regime.” Bessent disse à Reuters no domingo que o Departamento do Tesouro dos EUA provavelmente anunciaria semanalmente novas sanções secundárias com o objetivo de aumentar a pressão econômica sobre o Irã, com foco inicial nos bancos. Ele disse que o próximo passo pode ser isolar completamente uma instituição do sistema financeiro baseado no dólar. Em uma mensagem dirigida à IRGC, Bessent disse nesta terça-feira: “Sabemos onde, nas Ilhas Virgens Britânicas, estão suas contas nessas empresas fiduciárias. Sabemos das casas de US$100 milhões que vocês possuem ao redor do mundo, e vamos congelá-las”. Bessent disse que os Estados Unidos discutiram em particular com a China como impedir que o Irã obtenha uma arma nuclear e garantir a liberdade de navegação no Estreito de Ormuz. (Reportagem de David Lawder)

item.title: Precios al consumidor en Perú suben levemente en agosto
item.description: Los precios al consumidor en Perú subieron un 0,07% en agosto, según los datos publicados este martes por el Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Información (INEI).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los precios al consumidor en Perú subieron un 0,07% en agosto, según los datos publicados este martes por el Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Información (INEI). • Los datos se situaron algo por debajo de la previsión media del 0,1% de una encuesta de Reuters, y en comparación con el aumento del 0,29% registrado en julio. • Los precios de la vivienda, el agua, la electricidad, el gas y otros combustibles subieron un 0,87% en el mes, mientras que los de los restaurantes y hoteles y los del transporte registraron un aumento del 0,28%, según el INEI. • Por otro lado, los precios de los alimentos y las bebidas no alcohólicas cayeron un 0,66%. • Entre los productos alimenticios, el INEI destacó la bajada de los precios de los productos cárnicos, como el pollo. • La inflación interanual en Lima —el principal indicador de inflación del país— se aceleró hasta el 4,44% en los doce meses hasta agosto, frente al 4,07% de julio, manteniéndose por encima del rango objetivo del Banco Central, situado entre el 1% y el 3%.

item.title: 'Significant' number of EU countries back speeding up Ukraine funding, Ireland says
item.description: A significant number of European Union member states support bringing forward the disbursement of funds under an EU loan to Ukraine to help its war effort, Ireland's defence minister said on Tuesday after hosting a meeting of EU colleagues.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A significant number of European Union member states support bringing forward the disbursement of funds under an EU loan to Ukraine to help its war effort, Ireland's defence minister said on Tuesday after hosting a meeting of EU colleagues. Ukraine relies heavily on foreign funds in its fight against Russia , now in its fifth year, including a €90 billion loan that the EU agreed to disburse over the course of 2026 and 2027. New Ukrainian defence minister Yevhenii Khmara, who addressed EU ministers via video link at an informal gathering in Ireland, said on Sunday he would ask to bring forward part of the €45 billion in payments scheduled for next year. "What I think was very clear from our presentation from the (Ukrainian) defence minister is that there is a gap. So I do believe that there was a significant number of member states that supported that ask," Ireland's Helen McEntee told a press conference. As the gathering was informal, ministers were not in a position to make any formal decisions. McEntee, who hosted the meeting as Ireland currently holds the EU's rotating six-month presidency, added that any frontloading of the funds would need to be agreed by EU governments and the European Commission: "It is obviously beyond today but I think we need to advocate, insofar as possible, for bringing that forward."

item.dc:creator: Markus Wacket
item.content:encoded: Der Anschlag auf ein Umspannwerk nahe dem brandenburgischen Kohlekraftwerk Jänschwalde sollte nach Angaben der Regierung einen großflächigen Stromausfall auslösen. Unbekannte hätten leitfähiges Material in das Umspannwerk geschossen, um Kurzschlüsse auszulösen, sagte Brandenburgs Innenminister Jan Redmann (CDU) am Dienstag. "Das ist in zwei Fällen auch gelungen." Es sei ein Feuerball beobachtet worden. Kurzzeitig war eine Leitung ausgefallen. Ein Stromausfall sei aber verhindert worden, auch weil es Ersatzleitungen gegeben haben. Die Täter seien systematisch vorgegangen. "Das war kein Kinderstreich." Noch immer werde von Entschärfern nach weitere Flugkörpern gesucht, mit denen das Material abgeschossen wurde. "Wir sind viel zu verwundbar in Deutschland", sagte Redmann am frühen Abend mit Blick auf die kritische Infrastruktur. Die Aufklärung werde mit Hochdruck vorangetrieben. Über mögliche Täter und Motive könne man aber noch nicht sprechen. Der Chef des Kraftwerksbetreibers Leag, Adolf Roesch, sagte, ein 500-Megawatt-Block des Kraftwerks Jänschwalde sei in der Folge ausgefallen. Er solle aber im Laufe des Abends wieder hochgefahren werden. Brandenburgs Ministerpräsident Dietmar Woidke hatte zuvor gesagt, man nehme die Angriff auf die kritische Infrastruktur sehr ernst. "Die besorgniserregend hohe Frequenz derartiger Vorfälle zeigt, dass wir unsere Infrastrukturen entschlossen schützen müssen." Die Beschäftigten hätten besonnen gehandelt und Schlimmeres verhindert. "Wer versucht, unsere kritische Infrastruktur zu sabotieren und das gesellschaftliche Leben zu lähmen, greift uns alle an. Aber wir lassen uns von krimineller Energie weder erpressen noch verunsichern." OFFENBAR SELBSTGEBASTELTE RAKETEN IM EINSATZ Das Landeskriminalamt (LKA) hat inzwischen die Ermittlungen übernommen. Die Polizei sei um acht Uhr morgens über eine Sachbeschädigung informiert worden. Eine Sprecherin des Netzbetreibers 50hertz erklärte, nach bisherigen Erkenntnissen seien selbstgebaute Flugkörper eingesetzt worden, die handelsüblichen Silvesterraketen ähnelten. Der Vorfall weckt Erinnerungen an den Brandanschlag auf das Berliner Stromnetz mit einem großflächigen Blackout zum Jahreswechsel. Er geht vermutlich auf das Konto von Linksextremisten. Vor gut einem Monat wurde zudem mit Drohnen und Sprengstoff ein Anschlagsversuch auf den Leipziger Frachtflughafen unternommen. In der Nähe standen ukrainische Frachtflugzeuge vom Typ Antonow. Sicherheitsexperten gehen hier von einer Verbindung zu Russland aus. Am Abend wollten sich Innenminister Alexander Dobrindt (CSU) und Außenminister Johann Wadephul (CDU) dazu äußern.

item.title: Tronchon claims surprise Vuelta stage 10 victory in chaotic sprint
item.description: Bastien Tronchon of Groupama-FDJ United snatched victory in a photo finish on stage 10 of the Vuelta a Espana on Tuesday following a 184.7 km hilly ride through southern Spain.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bastien Tronchon of Groupama-FDJ United snatched victory in a photo finish on stage 10 of the Vuelta a Espana on Tuesday following a 184.7 km hilly ride through southern Spain. The pace quickened a kilometre before the finish line as Astana's Yevgeni Fedorov broke clear alongside Xabier Azparren of Q36.5, building a brief lead over the peloton before being caught just before the finish line and allowing Frenchman Tronchon to secure a surprise victory in the final sprint. Denmark's Magnus Cort of Uno-X Mobility took second place and Belgian Thibau Nys of Lidl-Trek finished third. The victory marked the 24-year-old’s first Grand Tour stage win and the third of his career . "I launched my sprint and finished on the line – I wasn’t sure if there were some guys in front. I didn’t put my hands in the air," Tronchon said. "My preparation this year wasn’t very good so I didn’t expect this. I just had to trust the process, to race and go for it." Spain's Enric Mas of Movistar retained the overall leader's red jersey, finishing safely in 36th place in the main peloton.

item.title: Energy firms face AI-enhanced cyber attacks in connectivity push
item.description: AI is boosting the efficiency of cyber attacks in the increasingly digitalized energy sector and companies with less resources could benefit from standardized defense plans.
item.dc:creator: Eduardo Garcia
item.content:encoded: Energy companies are at risk from AI-aided cyber attacks, as vast networks of power generation, transmission and distribution have been digitalized and interconnected, effectively offering a large attack surface for hackers. Ukraine’s energy infrastructure has been systematically targeted by Russian hackers since the start of the Russia-Ukraine war, and Poland has faced similar attacks, including one in December that aimed to disrupt the communication between renewable energy installations and power distribution operators. Last month, U.S. officials warned unidentified hackers were trying to breach devices made by Siemens that are used across multiple critical infrastructure sectors, including energy and manufacturing. Following media reports that Iran-linked hackers had shut down a small British energy facility, the UK in late August briefed energy company chiefs on steps to protect their assets, saying there was no threat to the wider electricity system. Researchers at British cybersecurity company Bridewell said RomCom, a Russian-aligned hacking group, very likely used AI to generate social engineering content to target organizations in Critical National Infrastructure (CNI) sectors in the U.K. in 2025. These attacks illustrate how hacking groups, many of which are affiliated with hostile governments such as Russia, Iran, and China, are increasingly targeting companies across critical infrastructure and many are relying on AI to increase the number and sophistication of their exploits, sources said. CHART: Cyber attacks per week per energy organization Source: International Energy Agency (IEA) Some of these hackers are using AI to build scripts that attack operational technology assets, such as programmable logic controllers used across power generation facilities, as well as substations that control the flow of power. “Those have been created by Iranian-aligned actors and are being used as part of that ever-increasing volume of attacks we're seeing,” Phil Tonkin, Field Chief Technology Officer at Dragos, a leading cybersecurity firm, told Reuters Events. Large language models (LLMs) allow hackers without technical know-how to “automate a large percentage of a typical attack path,” hence “lowering the resources, time, and expertise” needed to carry out attacks, said Rob Denaburg, Senior Manager for Cybersecurity at the American Public Power Association, which represents 1,400 community-owned, not-for-profit public power utilities in the United States. Operational technology assets use protocols to communicate. “AI is enabling people to design attacks that can speak the protocol language without having to take the time to become basically an engineer to learn how to do all that,” Denaburg said. Download our exclusive report on U.S. grid investment trends. AI tools are also being used to identify vulnerabilities in energy systems, allowing adversaries to “increase the speed, the scale, and the efficiency of their attacks,” said Kieran Bhardwaj, Director of Technical Services at Bridewell. Attackers rely on AI to sort through “large amounts of information of all the different potential targets they could take out there, and find out which ones are vulnerable in just the right ways at just the right times,” Bhardwaj said. Cyber attackers can deploy AI tools to create a so-called “Cyber Kill Chain” to map the sequential vulnerabilities that can be targeted to carry out a successful exploit, Denaburg said. Budget constraints, older assets Large energy companies have bolstered their cybersecurity because they are increasingly aware of the dangers, but smaller utilities are “easy prey,” said Leo Simonovich, VP and Global Head, Industrial Cyber and Digital Security at Siemens Energy. “If you look at the United States, once you go outside the top 100, there are a bunch of small utilities that are facing the challenge, and those folks are what I would consider to be the weakest link,” Simonovich told Reuters Events. Smaller U.S. utilities, especially those that operate in rural areas, lack the resources to rapidly scale their cyber defenses and even though they may hire the services of cybersecurity companies, they lack a dedicated workforce to implement safety measures around the clock, Denaburg said. Join 1,500+ senior decision-makers across energy and finance at Reuters Events Energy LIVE 2026 . Older equipment that lacks programmable security features is more vulnerable to hacking. “I don't think budget is necessarily the be-all and end-all of this challenge. I would actually say the amount of legacy equipment an organization has is a much more indicative stance to how hard their cyber security maturity journey is going to be,” Bhardwaj said. And while large generation plants often feature “some very sophisticated” cybersecurity controls, renewable energy facilities that “typically just connect straight to the internet with one layer of control” are also vulnerable to attacks, Tonkin said. For developers, “it's not easy to justify expenditure on sophisticated monitoring, or multiple firewalls” when they are building and operating a small solar farm, he said. Security guidelines To boost their defenses in the face of increasing cyberattacks, smaller utilities should perform an asset inventory to identify weaknesses, embed monitoring and detection, enable software updates and test patches, Simonovich said. The energy industry could benefit from “blueprints” of standardized cybersecurity measures that all equipment manufacturers would have to follow, he added. For example, Siemens is working with global risk management company DNV to produce cybersecurity standards for offshore wind turbines. For exclusive energy insights, sign up to our newsletter . Tonkin said that although cybersecurity experts sometimes want to deploy “sophisticated standards with hundreds of controls,” the SANS Five Industrial Control Systems (ICS) Cybersecurity Critical Controls, are a reliable set of safeguards to secure critical infrastructure. This framework created by the Sans Institute, a for-profit cybersecurity training company, focuses on dedicated incident response, defensible network architecture, continuous passive monitoring, secure remote access, and risk-based vulnerability mitigation. Other public and private groups such as the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), the American Public Power Association, and OffSec, offer cybersecurity training courses and materials. Energy companies could also deploy AI tools to identify and patch vulnerabilities, and to put up “strategic blockers” to neutralize “Cyber Kill Chains.” “AI can be really good for helping prioritize where you might make limited investments,” Denaburg said. But preventive work is time consuming and slow because companies often need to test patches to ensure that they won’t cause “any unpredictable or unexpected behavior in your system, which could end up disrupting power,” Denaburg noted. “It's a bit of an uphill battle. Defenders have to be right 100 percent of the time, and attackers only have to be right once,” he said.

item.title: Vendas da BYD mantêm sequência de crescimento graças a fortes exportações
item.description: A fabricante chinesa de veículos elétricos BYD , registrou um aumento nas vendas globais pelo quarto mês consecutivo, à medida que exportações robustas continuaram a amenizar o impacto da demanda doméstica fraca.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A fabricante chinesa de veículos elétricos BYD (002594.SZ) , registrou um aumento nas vendas globais pelo quarto mês consecutivo, à medida que exportações robustas continuaram a amenizar o impacto da demanda doméstica fraca. As vendas totais em agosto subiram 17,8% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior, chegando a 440.293 veículos, enquanto as exportações dispararam 134,5%, somando 189.466 unidades, de acordo com cálculos da Reuters baseados nos dados divulgados pela BYD nesta terça-feira. A BYD tem liderado as ambições internacionais das montadoras chinesas, ganhando espaço em mercados importantes do exterior, buscando diversificar-se para além do mercado da China, cada vez mais saturado. Essa estratégia está contribuindo para a lucratividade. A maior montadora mundial de veículos elétricos gerou mais receita no exterior do que na China pela primeira vez no período de janeiro a junho, com o aumento das exportações. O Brasil, maior mercado da BYD fora da China, tornou-se um pilar fundamental desse crescimento no exterior. A empresa lançou recentemente seu primeiro veículo híbrido plug-in flex produzido localmente no país, ampliando presença fabril no maior mercado automotivo da América Latina. A BYD já é a quarta maior marca do Brasil em vendas segundo dados acumulados de janeiro a julho compilados pela associação de concessionários de veículos Fenabrave. A montadora chinesa terminou julho com uma participação no mercado brasileiro de 7,54%, à frente de Hyundai, Toyota, Renault, Jeep e Honda e atrás de Fiat, Volkswagen e GM. A rival chinesa GWM (601633.SS) entrou para o ranking na décima posição. A BYD vendeu 122,5 mil veículos no Brasil de janeiro ao final de julho, enquanto a GWM, 44,5 mil, segundo os dados da Fenabrave. A crescente contribuição dos mercados internacionais serviu de amortecedor contra a queda na lucratividade na China. A BYD registrou seu primeiro aumento trimestral no lucro em mais de um ano, embora a recuperação no segundo trimestre tenha ficado aquém das expectativas, já que a concorrência no mercado automotivo chinês continuou intensa. (Por Qiaoyi Li, Zhang Yan e Ju-min Park)

item.title: סרטון מרעידת אדמה בקולומביה יוחס באופן שגוי לרעידת האדמה בפרו
item.description: סרטון שבו נראים אנשים מחוץ למלון, לצד כנסייה המתנדנדת במהלך רעידת אדמה, הופץ ברשתות החברתיות כאילו תיעד את רעידת האדמה שהתרחשה בפרו. אולם הסרטון צולם למעשה בקולומביה, עשרה ימים קודם לכן.
item.dc:creator: בדיקת עובדות רויטרס
item.content:encoded: סרטון שבו נראים אנשים מחוץ למלון, לצד כנסייה המתנדנדת במהלך רעידת אדמה, הופץ ברשתות החברתיות כאילו תיעד את רעידת האדמה שהתרחשה בפרו. אולם הסרטון צולם למעשה בקולומביה, עשרה ימים קודם לכן. להלן העובדות המרכזיות: הסרטון שותף ברשתות החבריות ב-20 באוגוסט לצד כיתובים שלפיהם הוא מתעד את רעידת האדמה [USN:APNA25DZW TEXT:"בעוצמה 6.7"] שהתרחשה בפרו ב-20 באוגוסט. למעשה הסרטון מתעד את רעידת האדמה [USN:L1N3AC29B TEXT:"בעוצמה 7.4"] שפקדה את מערב קולומביה עשרה ימים קודם לכן. רויטרס איתרה את מיקום הסרטון בעיר פריירה שבקולומביה באמצעות השוואת מלון קסטיליה ריאל (Castilla Real Hotel), כניסיית איגלסיה סן חוסה (Iglesia San José), המבנים הסמוכים וסימני הדרך ברחוב בין הפרטים המופיעים בסרטון. סרטון נוסף שצולם באותו אזור שודר ב-CNN ב-10 באוגוסט, ותיעד את הרגע שבו רעידת האדמה פגעה בעיר. הסרטון צולם בעיר פריירה שבמערב קולומביה במהלך רעידת אדמה ב-10 באוגוסט, ופורסם לראשונה בחשבונות הפייסבוק והטיקטוק של אדם בשם חוסה פיאמו. פיאמו ציין בחשבון הטיקטוק שלו כי צילם את הסרטון מול מלון קסטיליה ריאל בפריירה, שבו עבד, והוסיף כי הצילומים מתעדים את הרגע שבו רעידת האדמה התרחשה ואת הדקות שלאחריה. המלון שלא השיב לפניית רויטרס לקבלת תגובה, אולם מסר בפוסט ברשתות החברתיות ב-12 באוגוסט כי נסגר באופן זמני בעקבות האירועים האחרונים, כדי לנקוט את האמצעים המתאימים להבטחת ביטחונם של האורחים והעובדים. פסק דין: כיתוב שגוי. הסרטון אינו מתעד את רעידת האדמה שהתרחשה החודש בפרו, אלא את רעידת האדמה המוקדמת יותר בקולומביה. מאמר זה הופק על ידי צוות בדיקת העובדות של רויטרס. קראו עוד על עבודת בדיקת העובדות שלנו.

item.title: El Himalaya se enfrenta a graves riesgos de inundaciones en próximos años, dice responsable de ONU
item.description: La región del Himalaya se enfrenta a graves riesgos derivados de nuevas inundaciones glaciares, dijo un alto cargo de la ONU, cuando las muertes por la inundación de la semana pasada en Nepal, provocada por el desprendimiento de un glaciar, ya han superado las 1.000.
item.dc:creator: Rick Noack
item.content:encoded: La región del Himalaya se enfrenta a graves riesgos derivados de nuevas inundaciones glaciares, dijo un alto cargo de la ONU, cuando las muertes por la inundación de la semana pasada en Nepal, provocada por el desprendimiento de un glaciar, ya han superado las 1.000. No solo se ve amenazada la energía hidroeléctrica de la que dependen muchas personas, sino que las riberas de los ríos, donde viven millones de personas, podrían quedar prácticamente inhabitables. "La tecnología no avanza lo suficientemente rápido como para evitar pérdidas en estos enormes sistemas fluviales que recogen el desbordamiento de los lagos glaciares", dijo a Reuters en una entrevista Kanni Wignaraja, secretaria general adjunta de la ONU. En 2020, los investigadores identificaron 47 lagos glaciares potencialmente peligrosos en Nepal, China y la India. Desde entonces, se estima que la cifra real es significativamente mayor. La población en riesgo "asciende a millones", dijo Wignaraja, que también ejerce como directora regional para Asia y el Pacífico del Programa de las Naciones Unidas para el Desarrollo (PNUD). Citó datos actualizados recopilados por el PNUD y organizaciones asociadas en junio. La devastadora inundación de la semana pasada en Nepal se desencadenó cuando partes de un glaciar cercano al pico del Langtang Lirung se derrumbaron y cayeron al fondo del valle, provocando un deslizamiento de tierra que envió un alud por el río Trishuli. Las roturas de lagos glaciares son un fenómeno algo diferente: ocurren cuando el agua procedente del deshielo de los glaciares se acumula detrás de una barrera natural y la presión acaba provocando una rotura o un desbordamiento que envía una crecida repentina río abajo. Ambas amenazas van en aumento, según funcionarios de la ONU, ya que el cambio climático acelera el deshielo de los glaciares en la región, lo que afloja las rocas y ejerce una mayor presión sobre las barreras de los lagos glaciares. Las montañas de la región también son relativamente jóvenes, señaló Wignaraja, y, por lo tanto, más propensas a sufrir desplazamientos tectónicos que también pueden provocar derrumbes repentinos de glaciares o de las barreras de los lagos. NEPAL DEPENDE EN GRAN MEDIDA DE LOS GLACIARES Los investigadores han detectado lagos glaciares potencialmente peligrosos en amplias zonas de la región del Hindu Kush. Sin embargo, Wignaraja señaló que ningún país de la región depende tanto de los glaciares, tanto para el abastecimiento de agua como para sus ingresos, como Nepal, que ahora se enfrenta a "unas decisiones muy, muy difíciles". Para muchas personas que viven a orillas de los ríos, trasladarse a terrenos más altos puede no ser viable desde el punto de vista económico. Las infraestructuras críticas también seguirán siendo vulnerables. La pérdida de producción eléctrica de Nepal podría ser más grave de lo que indican algunas evaluaciones. El PNUD señaló que la inundación había destruido 15 grandes centrales eléctricas en construcción, además de las que estaban en funcionamiento. Wignaraja señaló que las redes eléctricas y las centrales hidroeléctricas podrían hacerse más resistentes a las inundaciones gracias a las nuevas tecnologías. Sin embargo, el "tsunami de barro y hielo" de la semana pasada habría superado la mayoría de las defensas disponibles. "No hay ninguna construcción que pudiera haberlo detenido", afirmó.

item.title: Moraes descartou impedimento para escritório da esposa atender Banco Master, diz nota
item.description: O ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), descartou qualquer impedimento para que o escritório de advocacia liderado pela sua esposa, Viviane de Barci, firmasse um contrato para prestar consultoria jurídica para o Banco Master, do banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro, disse o escritório de advocacia em nota divulgada nesta terça-feira.
item.dc:creator: Ricardo Brito
item.content:encoded: O ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), descartou qualquer impedimento para que o escritório de advocacia liderado pela sua esposa, Viviane de Barci, firmasse um contrato para prestar consultoria jurídica para o Banco Master, do banqueiro Daniel Vorcaro, disse o escritório de advocacia em nota divulgada nesta terça-feira. Segundo a manifestação, o setor de compliance do escritório, em virtude da abrangência do contrato entre Master e a banca de advocacia, solicitou informações a Moraes, "na condição de marido da sócia diretora do referido escritório, sobre a eventual existência de impedimentos legais para a contratação nos termos propostos na minuta contratual, tais como ações no STF sobre sua relatoria ou mesmo participação em julgamentos de interesse do possível cliente". "Diante da inexistência de previsão de atuação no STF ou de qualquer impedimento legal, uma vez que o ministro Alexandre de Moraes jamais julgou qualquer causa envolvendo o Banco Master, o contrato foi assinado e os serviços advocatícios devidamente prestados", ressaltou a nota. Uma reportagem publicada nesta terça-feira pelo site do jornal Estado de S. Paulo, com base em investigação feita pela Polícia Federal, afirmou que Moraes editou o contrato de R$131 milhões do escritório liderado por sua mulher com o Master. Conforme a PF, metadados do documento enviado pelo WhatsApp da esposa do ministro do STF ao banqueiro registraram alterações feitas ao arquivo do contrato. Em março, o escritório da mulher do ministro havia confirmado ter prestado os serviços ao Master. Procurado por meio da assessoria, Moraes não respondeu de imediato a pedido de comentário. A investigação sobre o Master no Supremo está sendo conduzida pelo ministro André Mendonça, relator do caso. MENDONÇA PEDE MANIFESTAÇÃO DA PGR Em outra frente, Mendonça pediu à Procuradoria-Geral da República que se manifeste sobre um documento produzido pela PF em que haveria uma suposta mensagem de Vorcaro a Moraes que mencionaria um questionamento do banqueiro a Moraes sobre se seria possível "reverter" o andamento das investigações contra ele junto a "Paulo" e "Andrei", uma referência indireta, respectivamente, ao procurador-geral da República, Paulo Gonet, e ao diretor-geral da Polícia Federal, Andrei Rodrigues. O caso foi revelado pelo site Metrópoles e reportado por outros veículos de comunicação e confirmado pela Reuters com uma fonte com conhecimento direto do assunto. Uma fonte da PGR disse à Reuters nesta terça-feira que Gonet não teria o que fazer na ocasião porque o caso estava correndo totalmente na primeira instância, e os procuradores lá têm independência funcional. Tanto, ressaltou a fonte, que Vorcaro foi preso mesmo assim em novembro. Mendonça deu prazo de cinco dias para que a PGR se manifeste sobre o caso. Procurados por meio das assessorias, Moraes, Gonet e Rodrigues não responderam de imediato a pedido de comentário. O Banco Master foi liquidado em novembro do ano passado, época em que Vorcaro foi preso pela primeira vez em uma investigação da PF. Solto posteriormente, ele voltou a ser preso preventivamente em março.

item.title: Law firm A&O Shearman hires Texas ex-judge who dominated patent cases
item.description: Former U.S. District Judge Alan Albright, whose court in Waco, Texas, was once the most prominent venue in the United States for patent litigation, has joined international law firm A&O Shearman as an intellectual property litigation partner in Austin, the firm said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: Former U.S. District Judge Alan Albright, whose court in Waco, Texas, was once the most prominent venue in the United States for patent litigation, has joined international law firm A&O Shearman as an intellectual property litigation partner in Austin, the firm said on Tuesday. Under Albright, the Waco courthouse became the [USN:L2N2N82MA TEXT:"busiest U.S. patent court"], at one point hearing around 25% of all patent cases in the country. Albright, 66, [USN:L1N4150P7 TEXT:"announced his departure"] from the bench in April. He had relocated from Waco to Austin last year. The judge was a patent litigator at Bracewell LLP before being appointed to the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Texas by President Donald Trump in 2018. "After years on the federal bench, I’m excited to return to client work and trial practice at A&O Shearman,” Albright said in a statement, citing what he described as the firm's ties to the tech sector and expanding presence in Texas. A&O Shearman was [USN:L1N3EN2C3 TEXT:"created in 2024"] by the merger of London-founded Allen & Overy and New York's Shearman & Sterling. Laetitia Benard, the firm's global head of IP Litigation, in a statement said Albright "has presided over many of the country's most significant IP and technology disputes, and his experience will be invaluable to clients navigating complex cases." Patent owners flocked to Albright's court in part because of the fast pace with which he handled their cases. Critics, including Republican Senator Thom Tillis of North Carolina and Democratic Senator Patrick Leahy of Vermont, said that Albright improperly solicited patent plaintiffs to sue in his court and attracted “patent trolls” that generate revenue solely by raising infringement claims. The senators in a [USN:L1N2RU2KX TEXT:"2021 letter"] expressed concerns about the "extreme concentration" of cases in Albright's court and the "unseemly and inappropriate conduct that has accompanied this phenomenon." That letter was directed to Chief U.S. Supreme Court Justice John Roberts, who in response [USN:L1N2TJ0ZX TEXT:"pledged to direct"] the Judicial Conference of the United States to address how venue is chosen for patent cases. Albright [USN:L2N2N82MA TEXT:"told Reuters in 2021"] that he considered negative perceptions of his court to be "pretty much from outside the bubble." The Western District of Texas' then-chief judge, Orlando Garcia, [USN:L1N2Z70WE TEXT:"moved to break up"] Albright’s patent docket in July 2022 by issuing an order that ensured that any new patent cases filed in Waco would be randomly assigned. The district's share of new U.S. patent cases was down to 11.5% in 2025, according to a report from Unified Patents , while the Eastern District of Texas was the most prominent U.S. patent court with 27.7% of patent case filings. item.title: IMF, Senegal reach staff-level deal for $2.2 billion lending programme, debt restructuring
item.description: The International Monetary Fund and Senegal reached a staff-level agreement for a three-year, $2.2 billion loan package that will require Senegal to seek debt treatment "to restore debt sustainability", the IMF said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Anait Miridzhanian, Portia Crowe
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund and Senegal reached a staff-level agreement for a three-year, $2.2 billion loan package that will require Senegal to seek debt treatment "to restore debt sustainability", the IMF said on Tuesday. In a separate statement, Senegal's ministry of economy and finance said it had agreed to restructure debt under an "enhanced common framework", which it said would "provide a tailored response to the specific characteristics of Senegal's debt composition". Senegal is grappling with a debt burden that reached 132% of gross domestic product at the end of 2024, according to IMF figures, after the government uncovered billions of dollars in misreported borrowing by the previous administration. The IMF estimates misreported debt at more than $11 billion based on end-2023 numbers. Some analysts put it closer to $13 billion - more than a quarter of the country's $40 billion economy. The IMF froze a $1.8 billion lending programme after the discovery, and the two sides have been in contentious, drawn-out talks over a replacement. Senegalese officials "have announced their intention to seek debt treatment in order to restore debt sustainability", the IMF statement said. The deal announced on Tuesday requires Senegal to take "decisive corrective actions" in support of its request for a waiver related to the misreported debt, the IMF statement said. It is subject to approval by the IMF management and board, it added.

item.title: TCL sues Samsung for false advertising over 'Mini LED' televisions
item.description: Chinese consumer electronics company TCL has sued South Korea's Samsung in Los Angeles federal court, accusing its rival of falsely advertising some televisions as using "Mini LED" technology.
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: Chinese consumer electronics company TCL (1070.HK) has sued South Korea's Samsung (005930.KS) in Los Angeles federal court, accusing its rival of falsely advertising some televisions as using "Mini LED" technology. The lawsuit , filed on Monday, alleges Samsung falsely marketed its M Model televisions as featuring the technology , which is designed to improve picture quality. Samsung "took a cheap, non-Mini LED model from a recycled product line and peddled it to the public as a 'supreme' Mini LED model at an attractive price point," TCL said. Spokespeople for Samsung did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Tuesday. "Samsung's false advertising misled consumers who wanted the higher picture quality associated with Mini LED televisions into buying Samsung's falsely labeled product, unfairly damaging TCL's sales, goodwill, and valuable technology in the process," TCL attorney R.C. Harlan said in a statement. TCL's lawsuit said that the Mini LED technology in its televisions delivers "substantially better picture with greater dynamic range and higher contrast ratios." The company said it overtook Samsung in U.S. Mini LED television sales between 2023 and 2025 because Samsung failed to develop Mini LED televisions at a competitive price. TCL said Samsung launched its M Model televisions in March at prices below TCL's cheapest Mini LED televisions and advertised them as featuring Mini LED technology. But the lawsuit alleges that M Model televisions "contain none of the technological advancements associated with Mini LED technology" and are "recycled" from Samsung's standard LED televisions. "This age-old tale of corporate greed proved successful, as Samsung's sham products stole back TCL's hard-won market share," TCL said. TCL asked the court for an order blocking Samsung's "Mini LED" technology and an unspecified amount of monetary damages.

item.title: Jehovah's Witnesses say six believers sentenced in Russia on evidence from 'bereaved' informant
item.description: Six Jehovah's Witnesses have been convicted of "extremist" activity in Russia after being entrapped by an informant of the FSB security service who posed as a bereaved woman seeking comfort in religion, a spokesperson for the faith group said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Mark Trevelyan
item.content:encoded: Six Jehovah's Witnesses have been convicted of "extremist" activity in Russia after being entrapped by an informant of the FSB security service who posed as a bereaved woman seeking comfort in religion, a spokesperson for the faith group said on Tuesday. Two of the accused, Zaur Murtuzov and Darya Petrochenko, were sentenced last week to five years each in a penal colony. Four other women received compulsory labour sentences of up to four years. The Jehovah's Witnesses are a Christian movement known for door-to-door evangelism and a literal approach to studying the Bible. Russia banned them in 2017 as an "extremist organisation". The European Court of Human Rights ruled in 2022 that the ban was unlawful. It has been similarly condemned by the U.N. Human Rights Committee. Jarrod Lopes, a New York-based spokesperson, said the latest case was based on testimony from a woman who had infiltrated the group in 2022 after picking up a card in a cemetery that contained the message "There is Hope" and gave contact information. The woman said she had suffered a bereavement and expressed interest in the Bible. Over the next two years she cultivated the group of believers, secretly recording conversations with them and delivering them to the FSB, Lopes said. He said the exploitation of the group's kindness to a stranger proved "how wrong it is to criminalize a faith that makes people good neighbors". Before being sentenced, Petrochenko told the court that she was innocent, did not regret her actions and had not lost her faith in people. "I genuinely wanted to support a person who had supposedly lost a loved one. I asked nothing of her, nor did I offer her anything... I caused no harm to her or to the constitutional order," she said. According to the Jehovah's Witnesses, the FSB has frequently used informants to infiltrate prayer cells and make secret recordings in order to obtain evidence for prosecutions. Lopes said 174 Witnesses — 159 men and 15 women — are currently in prison in Russia.

item.title: Bond markets grow weary of tired deficit playbook
item.description: Amid a global government debt sell-off, the US Treasury is mashing together its favorite ideas for supposed fiscal rectitude. Withholding social funds to fight 'fraud,' upping tariffs and hoping for faster growth are meager responses to a $2 trln shortfall and 2007-style yields.
item.dc:creator: Gabriel Rubin
item.content:encoded: Amid a global government debt sell-off, the US Treasury is mashing together its favorite ideas for supposed fiscal rectitude. Withholding social funds to fight 'fraud,' upping tariffs and hoping for faster growth are meager responses to a $2 trln shortfall and 2007-style yields. Full view will be published shortly. Follow Gabriel Rubin on Bluesky and LinkedIn . Global bond yields traded at multiyear highs on September 1 as finance leaders from the Group of 20 gathered in Asheville, North Carolina for a ministerial meeting. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a CNBC interview on August 21 that there's a "very good chance" the federal deficit has peaked and that "several hundred billion dollars" could be saved by cutting waste, fraud and abuse from government spending. The United States on July 24 imposed new tariffs of 10% and 12.5% on goods from 60 trading partners, including the EU and China, alleging those countries failed to curb imports made by forced labor, just as a temporary 10% global tariff expired.
